correctness.rationale: Every ambient projective automorphism lifts faithfully to the normalization. The published cusp types force the unique \(A_6\) cusp preimage to be fixed and permit only permutations of the three \(A_2\) preimages. Scaling the four marked normalization points to \(0,1,\omega,\omega^2\), a fresh exact cross-ratio reconstruction shows precisely the three even permutations preserve the marked cross-ratio. Thus the stabilizer has order at most three. The explicit map \([s:t]\mapsto[\omega s:t]\) has the displayed coordinate characters and induces \([x:y:z]\mapsto[\omega x:\omega^2y:z]\), giving the matching subgroup.
